04 / 14.09.2023 Respondent State has filed counter affidavit.

At para-12 thereof, it has been stated that Ahmad Ansari, Kabiran Bibi, Aldi Bibi, Chaniya Bibi, Kushiya Bibi and Sahiban Mian have filed an objection before the Respondent No. 3 - District Land Acquisition Officer, Jamtara against the award which was prepared for paying compensation to the petitioner against the acquisition of the land appertaining to Khata No. 10, Plot No. 1640/3 of Mouza Kuruwa having an area of 05 decimals for construction of Jamtara-Karmatar-Laharjori Road 2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel for the Respondent State both submitted that as objection has been made by the private persons, Respondent No. 2 - Deputy Commissioner, Jamtara has to refer the matter to the competent authority, as per the provisions of section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. In view of the specific provisions of section 64 of the aforesaid Act, Respondent No. 2 - Deputy Commissioner, Jamtara is directed to refer the objection of the aforesaid persons to the competent authority within 30 days from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
4. With this direction, this writ application is disposed of.
